motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council request the City Attorney, with the assistance from the Department of Recreation and Parks, to prepare and present an Ordinance that would amend Los Angeles Municipal Code Section 86.04 to add language allowing: Bicycles and electric bicycles on paths designated or posted as a Class I Bikeways or other pathways where bicycle operation is allowed by the Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners; Pathways to be designated with speed limits for bicycles and electric bicycles and/or requirements to dismount and propel them by hand along the trail. PRESENTED BY: \DUelKe NITHYA RAMAN Councilmember, 4th District SECONDED BY: / Leece Auu U 4 2026
title: Bicycles and Electric Bicycles / Class I Bikeways / Speed Limits / Pathways / Los Angeles Municipal Code / Amendment
